images.card_depicts: Aerial overview of Kovalam Lighthouse Beach's crescent shape with its rocky southern headland and dense hotel/resort beachfront

Plausibly matches the general description (crescent beach, rocky headland, dense beachfront) better than the other four, but the whitewater patch cannot be confirmed as the reef break specifically - no caption on the source page ties this exact patch to the structure, and given the other four URLs on this same domain were shown to serve mismatched content, this one's authenticity as a genuine Kovalam photo (versus another reused/mislabeled file) cannot be fully trusted either.
images.reasoning: Generically consistent with Kovalam Lighthouse Beach's known shape, but does not clearly and verifiably show the reef structure or an unmistakable reef effect (the mid-water whitewater patch is ambiguous - could be a normal breaking wave, boat wake, or the reef, and no source-page caption resolves it). images.action: Keep only as generic site/location context, not as reef-evidence; do not caption it as showing the reef.
